shellCommands.command: ls -la && git status --short && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/ -R | head -100

cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; cat index.html; echo ---; ls -R src; for f in src/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; echo ---; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -40

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch useThemeType useThemeValue 2>&1 | head -60; echo ---; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; echo ---; rg -n -C 4 "ThemeProvider|theme|setTheme|useThemeType|dark|light" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -200

(curl -sS -m 30 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/uikit7-llms.txt; echo "exit=$?"; wc -c /tmp/uikit7-llms.txt; head -c 1500 /tmp/uikit7-llms.txt); echo; echo ---; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit versions --json 2>/dev/null | tail -15; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@7 version 2>/dev/null | tail -3; echo ---; ls -la .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/

cd /tmp && curl -sS -m 30 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/8/llms.txt -o /tmp/uikit8-llms.txt; echo "exit=$?"; wc -c /tmp/uikit8-llms.txt; rg -n -i "theme|migrat|breaking|upgrade" /tmp/uikit8-llms.txt | head -80; echo ---; rg -n -i "theme|migrat|breaking" /tmp/uikit7-llms.txt | head -60
cd /tmp && rg -n -i "theme" /tmp/uikit7-llms.txt | head -60; echo ---; rg -n "^#|\]\(" /tmp/uikit7-llms.txt | head -120

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider Switch useTheme useThemeValue useThemeType 2>&1; echo ---; cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && rg -n "useTheme|useThemeValue|useThemeType|ThemeProvider|ThemeType|ThemeValue" build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts build/esm/components/index.d.ts build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ---; ls build/esm/components/theme 2>/dev/null

cat build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; echo ---; cat build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/useThemeContext.d.ts; echo ---; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts; echo ---; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js | head -80

cat build/esm/components/controls/Switch/Switch.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg -l "SwitchProps" build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head; echo ---; rg -n "ThemeType|Switch|Text|Card|Flex" build/esm/components/index.d.ts build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; cat build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts | head -20; echo ---; rg -n -i "switch|theme" README.md | head -20

cat build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo ---; cat build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.js | head -60; echo ---; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(tsc|vite|vitest)$"; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && node_modules/.bin/tsc -v

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && rg -n "color\?|variant\?|export type TextColor|TextColor =" Text/Text.d.ts Text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; rg -n "view\?|size\?|type\?" Card/Card.d.ts | head; echo ---; rg -n "spacing|gap" Flex/Flex.d.ts Box/Box.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -rn "ThemeType" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls Text Flex Box 2>/dev/null; cat Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; cat Card/Card.d.ts | head -30; grep -rn "export" ../index.d.ts | head -5

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -30; echo ---; rg -n "spacing|gap" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/ 2>/dev/null
npx vite build --outDir /tmp/gv-build --emptyOutDir 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; git status --short
